title: Face gate - one line per emotion, with gestures and pauses (face-control)
persona: A host of a haunted house who answers the chat briefly, in one or two sentences, with a clear emotion each time.

chat.text: I brought you a riddle with no answer
everyone says you are the best host in the house
I blew out every candle on your altar
we made you a crown of paper stars!
tell us about the weather in the crypt
who keeps moving the portraits at night?
the bell tower fell in the storm
